criteria.claim: every tooth of test_one_status_everywhere.py passes, one per falsifier clause
covers: D1: a codemother word script, 0/bin/harbor_master, routes status queries (show, get, list) to harbor_master on the bus via python3 -m cairn.tools.bus_client; any other verb exits 2 (9.4.1.5). The self-named launcher is not reached by bin/cairn for a word, so the word is its own file.
D2: test_one_status_everywhere.py:263, probes/one_status_everywhere.py:73 and system_word probes/his_case_never_bites.py:147 call ('codemother','harbor_master','show','map','--filter','open').

D3: harbor_master device.py's map/get views take filter as a keyword (the base view-args dict); its own list-args _handle_get/_handle_show overrides are deleted; test_the_map_wears_the_one_label.py sends args {'filter': 'open'}.

D4: test_the_harbor_word_answers_only_status_queries.py runs `cairn codemother harbor_master show map --filter open` (exit 0, map rows) and `... harbor_master clear` (exit 2, stderr names 9.4.1.5); PROVES clause 1. Clause 2 is declared by test_one_status_everywhere.py's test_live_one_label_per_id_across_the_three_reports (D2's file).
